decisions.reason: The camera is close to the core offer and has kept its own page in both years. In a growing industry, with the firm hiring, performance seems to meet aspirations and there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The modular camera has a documented mission success (the ESA HERA launch), so it exceeds aspirations and strengthens the firm's heritage. Dropping it would make no sense.

Space situational awareness is a growing market that fits the firm's direction. The product has kept its own page, and organisational slack lets the firm carry it while its results are still uncertain.

The LiDAR is only mentioned rather than presented on its own page, so its results are less clear. Still, miniaturised sensors are a strategic direction, and slack plus long space sales cycles favour keeping it.
This newly launched radiation-hard camera is close to the core offer and has its own page. It is too early for a shortfall against aspirations to emerge.
The asteroid camera is tied to the successful HERA-related asteroid imaging heritage. Despite only a brief mention on the website, it is likely kept as a mission-specific capability.
